note: GDPR submodule for consent tracking. Revisionable content entity gdpr_consent_agreement (managed at /admin/config/gdpr/agreements; required base fields title, mode [implicit|explicit from ConsentAgreement::getModes()], description). Field type gdpr_user_consent + widget gdpr_consent_widget + formatter gdpr_consent_formatter. Plugin TYPE gdpr_consent_resolver (manager plugin.manager.gdpr_consent_resolver, annotation @GdprConsentUserResolver, namespace Plugin/Gdpr/ConsentUserResolver) with built-in resolvers gdpr_consent_user_resolver (user), gdpr_consent_node_resolver (node), gdpr_consent_profile_resolver (profile). Acceptances logged as message entities (template consent_agreement_accepted, view gdpr_log_messages). Permissions manage gdpr agreements, grant gdpr any consent, grant gdpr own consent. No single settings form (configure=null). Requires gdpr, token, message, entity_reference_revisions, views. Medium/hard ground in gdpr_consent_agreement entity CRUD (identified by title to stay robust against other agreements on the shared site). NOTE: this campaign completed the submodule's entity-schema install (installEntityType) that was skipped during the site's enable window.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal gdpr_consent module, what entity represents a consent agreement, is it revisionable, and where are agreements managed?
evals.expected_output: A revisionable content entity gdpr_consent_agreement, managed at /admin/config/gdpr/agreements (add/edit/delete/revisions). Required base fields include title, mode (implicit|explicit) and description.

evals.prompt: How do you collect a user's consent to an agreement with gdpr_consent - what field type, widget and formatter does it provide?
evals.expected_output: Attach a gdpr_user_consent field (widget gdpr_consent_widget, formatter gdpr_consent_formatter) to an entity/bundle (e.g. user or webform); the widget shows the agreement and records acceptance (logged as a message entity).

evals.prompt: gdpr_consent needs to know which user a consent record belongs to. Which plugin type provides this and what are the built-in resolvers?
evals.expected_output: The ConsentUserResolver plugin type (manager plugin.manager.gdpr_consent_resolver, annotation @GdprConsentUserResolver). Built-in resolvers: gdpr_consent_user_resolver (user), gdpr_consent_node_resolver (node -> author), gdpr_consent_profile_resolver (profile -> owner). A gdpr_user_consent field can only be added to a bundle that has a resolver.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a gdpr_consent consent agreement whose title starts with 'GDPR Eval'. Inspect the live site and state its consent mode (implicit or explicit).
evals.expected_output: The agreement 'GDPR Eval Consent' has mode 'explicit' (a gdpr_consent_agreement entity; mode field value explicit).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use gdpr_consent to create a consent agreement titled exactly 'GDPR Eval Task' with an explicit consent mode, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A gdpr_consent_agreement entity with title 'GDPR Eval Task' and mode 'explicit' exists. Create it via /admin/config/gdpr/agreements/add or with the gdpr_consent_agreement storage create([...])->save() (required fields title, mode, description).
